🧳 External / portable drive · 🧩 Corrupted / RAW / asks to format

Fix a Corrupted or Unreadable External Hard Drive

Corruption often follows pulling the cable without ejecting, a power cut, or failing parts. The files may still be there. Do not run repair tools on the original first, because they can change data.

3/5 · Take care
Success odds: Medium

The drive may be weak, and repair tools like CHKDSK on the original can change data before you have a copy.

✋ Stop! Don't do this first

  • Do not run CHKDSK, fsck, or Disk Utility repair on the original before copying your data.
  • Do not click Format when the computer says the drive needs formatting.
  • Do not install recovery software onto the affected drive or save files back to it.

Tools you'll use

GNU ddrescue

Copies a failing drive to an image file, retrying bad areas so you work from a copy, not the original.

  • Linux · macOS
  • Free (open source)

WebsiteDocs

ddrescueview

Free graphical viewer that shows which parts of a ddrescue image are good, bad or still unread.

  • Windows · Linux
  • Free (open source)

WebsiteDocs

HDDSuperClone

Linux tool for cloning a failing drive sector by sector, with options that skip and retry bad areas.

  • Free (open source)

🧑‍🔧 When to call a pro

If imaging keeps stalling, the drive makes noises, or the data is critical, stop and talk to a professional.

Questions people ask

Should I run CHKDSK first?

No. It can rewrite damaged data. Image the drive first and repair or recover from the copy.

Why does it say the drive is RAW?

The computer cannot read the file system, often because of an unsafe unplug or damage. TestDisk can often restore it.

Why can't I see SMART data?

Many USB enclosures do not pass it through. That is common and does not mean the drive is healthy.

Before you start: Educational DIY guide, no warranty. DIY recovery can cause permanent data loss. If the data is valuable, consider a professional first.
